stories.title: Kebakaran di Kebayoran Lama Jaksel Padam, Tak Ada Korban Jiwa

en.title: Fire in Kebayoran Lama South Jakarta Extinguished, No Fatalities
en.summary: A fire in South Jakarta's Kebayoran Lama district has been extinguished with no deaths reported. Investigators believe the fire was caused by an electrical short circuit.

stories.title: Tim Penyelam Tembus Kamar KM Virgo yang Tenggelam, Temukan Banyak Jasad

en.title: Divers Breach Cabin of Sunken KM Virgo, Discover Multiple Bodies
en.summary: A combined team of divers successfully accessed a cabin in the sunken KM Virgo vessel and discovered multiple bodies trapped inside.

stories.title: Polisi Bongkar Pabrik Rumahan Tembakau Sintetis di Gambir

en.title: Police Dismantle Synthetic Tobacco Drug Laboratory in Gambir
en.summary: Jakarta police dismantled a makeshift laboratory in Gambir that was producing synthetic tobacco narcotics. One suspect was arrested with evidence seized.

stories.title: Tim SAR temukan korban terseret banjir bandang di Kabupaten Solok

en.title: Search and Rescue Team Finds Victim Swept Away by Flash Flood in Solok Regency
en.summary: A combined search and rescue team located one of two people reported missing after a flash flood struck Solok Regency.

stories.title: BNPB pastikan tim bergerak cepat tangani dampak banjir bandang Solok

en.title: BNPB ensures team moves quickly to handle impacts of Solok flash floods
en.summary: Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency is ensuring swift and appropriate response to the impacts of flash flooding in Solok.

stories.title: RI-Aljazair Kerja Sama, Buka Pintu Investasi bagi Perusahaan Energi Indonesia

en.title: Indonesia-Algeria Cooperation Opens Investment Doors for Indonesian Energy Companies
en.summary: Indonesia and Algeria are strengthening energy cooperation, with Algeria offering investment opportunities for Indonesian oil and gas companies including state-owned Pertamina for regional expansion.

stories.title: Belarus ingin perluas kerja sama Indonesia dalam perdagangan hingga AI

en.title: Belarus seeks to expand cooperation with Indonesia in trade through AI
en.summary: Belarus is promoting expanded cooperation with Indonesia across multiple sectors including trade, economics, and artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Kebakaran Rumah Dekat Stasiun Kebayoran Lama Diduga Dipicu Korsleting

en.title: House Fire Near Kebayoran Lama Station Suspected to Be Triggered by Electrical Short Circuit
en.summary: A fire near Kebayoran Lama Station in South Jakarta, likely caused by electrical short circuit, affected 60 households with no fatalities reported.

stories.title: Basarnas: Penyelam tembus kamar KM Virgo dan temukan banyak jasad

en.title: Basarnas: Divers breach KM Virgo cabin and find many bodies
en.summary: Combined diving teams successfully accessed multiple cabins on the motor vessel KM Virgo involved in a maritime accident and discovered numerous victims.

stories.title: Menag Kaget Pemilihan Rektor UINSA Ditolak Mahasiswa

en.title: Religion Minister Surprised by Student Rejection of UINSA Rector Selection
en.summary: Indonesia's Religion Minister Nasaruddin Umar expressed surprise at students rejecting the rector selection process at UINSA. He stated he would examine the causes of the dispute and seek a resolution.

stories.title: VIDEO: Perkembangan Terkini Banjir Bandang yang Melanda Solok

en.title: VIDEO: Latest developments of flash floods affecting Solok
en.summary: A media correspondent provides coverage of ongoing flash flood developments in Solok, West Sumatra.

stories.title: 1 Orang Tewas Akibat Banjir Bandang Solok, Rumah-Kantor Pemerintahan Rusak

en.title: 1 Person Dies in Flash Flood in Solok, Government Buildings Damaged
en.summary: A flash flood in Solok Regency killed one person and left another missing. Search and rescue operations are ongoing.

stories.title: Tak Gentar Hadapi Trump, Menlu Iran Injakkan Kaki di New York

en.title: Unfazed by Trump, Iran's Foreign Minister Sets Foot in New York
en.summary: Iran's Foreign Minister arrived in the United States, marking the first visit by a senior Iranian official to American territory since Middle East tensions escalated.

stories.title: Perang Saudara Menggila di Arab, Ratusan Tewas-Pengungsi "Meledak"

en.title: Civil War Escalates in Arab Region, Hundreds Dead-Refugees 'Explode'
en.summary: Fighting between Houthi forces and Yemeni troops has intensified, resulting in 154 deaths. The UN warns of potential mass displacement affecting up to 10,000 people.

stories.title: Potret Topan Dujuan Bikin Jepang Porak-poranda, Korban Jiwa Berjatuhan

en.title: Typhoon Dujuan Devastates Japan, Deaths Mount
en.summary: Typhoon Dujuan triggered landslides and flooding in Japan's Kanto region, killing four people and leaving six missing. Extreme rainfall reached 686.5 millimeters in 24 hours.

stories.title: Iran Janji Buka Lagi Selat Hormuz dalam 7 Hari, dengan Syarat...

en.title: Iran Promises to Reopen Strait of Hormuz Within 7 Days, on Condition...
en.summary: Iran stated it would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week if the United States ends military pressure. Tehran is seeking a diplomatic resolution to reduce tensions.

stories.title: Alert! AS dan Inggris Tembak Torpedo Mematikan Lewat Drone Laut

en.title: Alert! US and UK Fire Lethal Torpedoes Via Underwater Drones
en.summary: The UK and US successfully tested torpedo deployment from underwater drones, marking a technological advancement. PM Burnham is promoting AI cooperation at the UN.
